---
title: "About"
description: "Who maintains this playbook, what it covers, and how to suggest a change."
title-block-banner: true
---

The NHSBSA Producing Quality Analysis Playbook is maintained by the Data Science, Advanced Analytics
and Statistics team.

It sets out how analysis is planned, produced, assured and communicated at NHSBSA, and it applies to
all analysis and datasets: published externally, used for internal decisions, or supplied to
sponsors and partners.

## Suggesting a change

This playbook is a repository, so a change to it is a pull request like any other.
[CONTRIBUTE.md](https://github.com/nhsbsa-data-analytics/nhsbsa-quality-analysis-playbook/blob/main/CONTRIBUTE.md)
explains how to raise something and how to send it. That is the same route the
[NHSBSA Analytical Code Assurance Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-analytical-code-assurance-playbook)
uses, so the two behave the same way.

If what you want to raise is not a change to the text, take it to the Data Science, Advanced
Analytics and Statistics team. [Who to ask](guidance/09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd) has the routes for
everything else.

## Change log

| 2.0 | Not yet published | **The refreshed playbook, in draft for NHSBSA review.**<br><br>Built on five phases and four roles, with a scored assurance level and the checks each level requires.<br><br>Adds a route for Business Critical analysis, and reference pages on uncertainty, ethics and transparency.<br><br>Aligned to GovS 010, the Code of Practice for Statistics 3.0 and the Data and AI Ethics Framework. |
| 1.0 | 11 June 2026 | **The playbook as it stood before the refresh**, published on NHSBSA's GitHub.<br><br>Covered the principles, the analytical cycle and responsibilities.<br><br>It carried no version number of its own. 1.0 is the number this log gives it. |
